errors.says: For both F=Q^h with x^T(I-J/9)y (bit) and F=F_2^h with the dot product (complex), the triple indicators satisfy <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1.
errors.paper: The formula <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1 (with <t_T,t_T>=2) is for the rational form only; for the binary label field the paper uses the ordinary dot product with t_T.t_T=1 (and t_S.t_T=|S cap T| mod 2). Read over F_2, |S cap T|-1 would make every triple line alternating (norm 0), the opposite of the nondegeneracy the paper uses. The conclusion (nondegenerate lines, neighbours orthogonal) is right.

errors.says: Motivation: the final multiplication by 2^{2b+4}S amplifies the error by at most 2^{2b+4}S 2^{-p}, which stays small only because p=6b leaves 4b spare bits.
errors.paper: The final error is 2^{2b+4}S * 28 2^gamma T^2 L * 2^{-6b} < 448b 2^{-b+gamma} <= 448b 2^{-3b/4} (eq. final-error); with S<=T<2^b and the T^2 factor in E_w, the net margin is about b-gamma bits, not 4b.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route end to end: scalar bank exchange (S1.1), frames (S1.2), nested labels and the dimension budget giving s<Wm (S1.3), the explicit exponent tau=sigma=1-2^-50 (S1.4), the two power-saving primitives with their recurrences (S1.5, S1.6), then synthetic transforms, ring convolution, resampling with retained permutations and chirps, assembly, precision and the cost table to O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) (S2-S6). It thins out in only a few places: the linear-time stream and controlled-shift lemmas are used but never stated, the opposite source transform F~^+ (defined by conjugation) is used without being defined, and the packed addition leaves out the separate top-bit XOR; none of these breaks the chain.

steps.note: h=100, v=161700, N=v^3 banks X_a,Y_a indexed by T^3, m=h^3, and a fixed linear network sending (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) while restoring every scratch wire, derived by the three-stage schedule.

Common frame D_v per gate commuting with the pointwise gate, implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, with edges paying only D_v D_u^{-1} and intermediate frames left free to make edges cheap (S1.2 motivation).

Nondegenerate labels in F^{tensor 3} of dimension m built from triple indicators (neighbours orthogonal), nested along every edge, with the only decreasing edges the central 3->4 returns losing h. (S1.3.1 has a minor slip on the binary form; see errors.)
P_V-P_U has rank dim V - dim U; the N source edges with matrix 2P_{U_a} are the rank-one exceptions where the dimension change is zero.
Source total N, sink total Wm-N, signed sum Wm-2N, absolute sum Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b (s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c).
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b>0 (and 2N-2L_c>0) and s<Wm.
M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role (P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m for X_a, zero/identity elsewhere), so with frames Phi_M the network gives H<-H+D on every row, scratch rows included.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, so a rank-a shear costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V); each edge is rank(A_e) recursive interchanges and a node makes exactly s calls.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^-50 obtained from eta>20*2^-50 and log m<20, and the geometric-sum solution F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: P01 rebuilds the whole chain behind the central saving with its defining content: the h=100 bank-exchange network, common frames, nested triple-indicator labels with the single decreasing central edge, rank equal to dimension change (with the N rank-one source exceptions), the budget Wm-2N+2L, the strict deficit from L/N=100/539, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D, edges as rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^-50. All nine steps are reconstructed.
